required_drop_boundaries: After startup acknowledgement and start_child return: no supervisor retained MFA args for temporary child; do not count persistent supervisor Q/C. Caller/start args are dead only when no continuation still retains them.

After group checkout: transfer/consume exactly the selected reply; never retain full member or reply alongside an extra selected-config sidecar. Count sender and receiver transfer roots during the boundary.

At handoff resume: clear awaiting_transport in the new state before checkout/open; charge old waiting state until callback transition ends. Handoff notification must carry only bounded identity and pins, never C/K/Q.

After selected-envelope assembly, BEFORE ManagedH2Client.open/Fetch: remove Neutral and selected full config from new live opening state/continuation where not needed; retain only envelope plus finite limits/control, selection tokens, pins and URL provenance. Clearing only after successful bind does not establish this pre-open boundary.

At prepare return: retain one complete request/accounting return, never charge request projection/accounting projection a second time. Release source/assembly scratch before using their slots for Fetch source arguments.

At Fetch return: discard complete preparation/accounting and source Fetch options; retain only validated handle/upload and required submitted_url. Do not retain a checked client in handle or extra sidecar.

After successful completion binding: clear request_options, managed_transport, selector, awaiting_transport, transport_handoff, and full fixed-config payload fields. Explicitly define group residual URL extraction because Neutral has no url.

On all opening, preparation, bind, cancellation, deadline and cleanup-unconfirmed paths: drop source/config/K when no longer needed without discarding original completion, cleanup identity, pins or tokens; failure paths require their own phase proof.
